messages:
mia: FYI I opened a tiny docs PR to clarify how tiered metering handles lots of tiny embedding calls and to add an SDK header example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123

 tara: Thanks. Can you add a minimal repro and the exact header snippet you want in the quickstart section? I'll polish the wording.

 mia: Repro summary in the PR: multiple near-simultaneous single-vector embedding requests get grouped into micro-batches by the runtime; metering sums per-batch then applies tier rounding which can differ from naive per-call rounding. Added a 2-row table and a short note: "Metering rounds after aggregation."

 kevin: We should show how to request per-call semantics. I added a compact Node + curl example using the header `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call`. Node snippet: 

 ```js
 // request per-call billing semantics
 await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
   method: 'POST',
   headers: {
     'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
     'x-redwood-billing-intent': 'per-call'
   },
   body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-small', input: ['a','b','c'] })
 });
 ```

 sam: Also updated the console pointerthe old docs referenced "Metering > Tiered Usage" but the Console now reads "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)". Fixed link.

 tara: Tiny copy edit: change heading "Workarounds" -> "When to request per-call billing" and swap "opt out" -> "request per-call semantics".

 kevin: Confirmed on staging the header tags requests for the metering actor. Filing RUNTIME-811 to ensure the header is surfaced in metering logs for audits.

 docs-bot: PR opened by mia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123  labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

 tara: I'll review and merge EOD if no issues.

 mia: Thanks all, leaving thread open for final checks."
